messages:
alex: Heads up — spotted a 404 in the onboarding KB when following the runtime quickstart. The cURL example links to a shortlink that redirects to a deleted gist. Anyone own that page?

mira: Which page exactly? can you paste the link? I can take ownership if it's in the onboarding flow.

alex: Page: https://internal.kb/redwood/runtime/quickstart 
Link in question: https://rwd.me/xyz123 -> 404
I ran `curl -I https://rwd.me/xyz123` and get `HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found`

sam: I can do a tiny PR to replace the shortlink with the canonical gist URL. Quick sed:
```
sed -i "s|https://rwd.me/xyz123|https://gist.github.com/elim/runme123|g" docs/runtime/quickstart.md
```
I'll open a PR in a few minutes.

jordan: Can we avoid shortlinks in runbooks? they've bitten us before. Maybe a linter to flag `rwd.me` domains? cc: @lia for CI rule

lia: Good call. We have a linkcheck job but it runs weekly. Quick steps:
- alex: can you add the broken URL to /tmp/broken-links.txt?
- I'll trigger the linkcheck job manually for docs/runtime
Also, we should add `docs:needs-owner` label on the PR.

alex: Added to /tmp/broken-links.txt and pushed to my fork. PR when ready, @sam :thumbsup: 

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/834 — small replace and note in changelog. Put `docs:urgent` label.

mira: I'll take ownership of runtime/quickstart moving forward. added myself to CODEOWNERS for that path in the PR.

docs-bot: linkcheck run started for docs/runtime — results will be posted in ~5m

alex: thanks all. if linkcheck finds any other rwd.me shortlinks, please @mention me and I'll batch-replace.

jordan: small follow-up — do we want a migration plan to rehost gists under our KB? bulk rehost queue? put on this week's docs sprint backlog.

mira: yes — added an item to the sprint board: "rehoming external gists used in onboarding". cc @product for prioritization.

lia: linkcheck finished — found 3 more shortlinks in docs/runtime. I'll paste results in the PR comments.

sam: responding to PR comments now, will include replacements and note the rehost TODOs.

alex: resolved, closing the thread once PR merges. thanks!
